name: Mossy Pile
summary: Mossy Pile is a small fortified goblin outpost situated just northwest of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Established by enterprising figures linked to Gadgetzan and working alongside Marshal Expeditions, the camp serves as a gritty forward base dedicated to harvesting the crater's dangerous riches for profit.

sections.title: A Venture in the Wilds
sections.body: Tucked away northwest of the smoldering slopes of Fire Plume Ridge, Mossy Pile offers a rare pocket of fortified civilization amid Un'Goro's untamed jungles. The camp is run by opportunistic goblins hailing from Gadgetzan who have aligned themselves with Marshal Expeditions. While others plumb the crater for scientific discovery or lost history, the operators at Mossy Pile are driven by pure commerce, setting up defenses to safely exploit Un'Goro's exotic flora, raw resources, and geologic wonders.

faq.answer: Mossy Pile is a fortified goblin camp located in central Un'Goro Crater, situated directly northwest of Fire Plume Ridge. It functions as a base for ventures tied to Gadgetzan and Marshal Expeditions.
The outpost is manned by goblins originating from Gadgetzan in Tanaris. They operate in conjunction with Marshal Expeditions to secure footholds and pursue commercial operations within the crater.

faq.q: Why are goblins out in the middle of Un'Goro Crater?
faq.answer: Un'Goro Crater is packed with rare minerals, exotic plants, and unique creatures. The goblins at Mossy Pile are here to exploit those natural resources and turn a healthy profit from the hazardous environment.

faq.q: Where does the flight master at Mossy Pile connect?
aliases: where can i fly from mossy pile
faq.answer: The flight master stationed at Mossy Pile maintains flight paths to Marshal's Stand elsewhere in Un'Goro, the desert city of Gadgetzan in Tanaris, and Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

angles.text: The goblin presence here provides a familiar spark of volatile ingenuity in the middle of a prehistoric jungle, serving as a reminder that no corner of Azeroth is free from goblin enterprise.
Because Marshal Expeditions maintains ties here, Alliance travelers working alongside Williden Marshal find the camp to be a valuable outpost in the southern wilds.
